title: Orion – Intelligent Personal AI Operating System
tagline: A portfolio-integrated AI assistant with persistent memory, automation workflows, and executive intelligence capabilities.
overview: Orion is an advanced AI-powered personal operating system embedded directly into my portfolio. It transforms a static portfolio into an intelligent, interactive interface capable of engaging visitors, answering contextual questions about my expertise, and automating real-world actions such as meeting scheduling.
problemStatement: Traditional portfolios are static and cannot dynamically represent skills, availability, or context-aware insights. Recruiters and clients often need to manually navigate, email, or schedule calls through multiple steps.
solution: Orion provides conversational intelligence, real-time scheduling automation, contextual skill explanations, and executive-level insights via an admin intelligence layer.
keyCapabilities: Conversational AI that explains skills, experience, and project depth dynamically
Authentication-based meeting scheduling with automatic Google Meet generation
Calendar synchronization and automated email invitations
Admin Orion for analytics, visitor insights, and engagement summaries
Connected email intelligence: summarize inbox, extract financial insights, search contextually
Graph-based memory architecture for long-term contextual awareness
technicalHighlights: Graph database powered memory retrieval instead of fixed message history
Context selection engine to reduce token usage while increasing relevance
Role-based access layer (Public vs Admin Orion)
LLM orchestration with contextual memory injection
impact: Orion acts as a 24/7 AI representative, automating professional communication while maintaining personalization and context awareness.

title: Altora – AI-Powered Digital Persona Network
tagline: A new category of AI-driven Q&A social platform built around expert digital personalities.
overview: Altora (derived from 'Alternate Aura') is a platform that enables domain experts, entrepreneurs, and industry leaders to build AI-powered digital personas. These personas continuously learn from structured domain-specific questioning and evolve to represent the expert’s thinking style and expertise.
problemStatement: Access to industry leaders and domain experts is limited. Most professionals cannot directly interact with top experts for guidance or insights.
solution: Altora creates continuously trained digital personas that simulate expert-level reasoning within defined domains, allowing global access to high-level thinking.
keyCapabilities: Structured domain training through guided AI interviews
Personality modeling aligned with communication style
Follow-based interaction model similar to social networks
technicalHighlights: Hybrid memory architecture for persona evolution
Prompt engineering aligned to personality tone
impact: Altora introduces a new paradigm where AI becomes a scalable extension of expert knowledge, enabling democratized access to domain intelligence worldwide.

title: Msherpa (Money Sherpa) – AI Financial Agent
tagline: A personalized AI financial advisory assistant built for U.S. citizens.
overview: Msherpa is a comprehensive AI-powered financial assistant designed to simplify personal finance decisions. It aggregates financial insights, analyzes user profiles, and provides actionable recommendations tailored to U.S. users.
problemStatement: Financial products such as credit cards, mortgages, and loans are complex and difficult to compare. Users often lack personalized guidance.
solution: Msherpa acts as an AI financial guide that analyzes user data and recommends optimal financial products and decisions.
impact: Msherpa simplifies financial decision-making by acting as an intelligent financial navigator for users.

title: PhysicsWallah Sahayak AI – Personalized Learning Assistant
tagline: AI-driven educational intelligence with adaptive learning paths.
overview: PhysicsWallah Sahayak AI is an AI-powered educational assistant built to support large-scale digital learning environments. It generates study material, answers academic queries, and creates personalized learning paths for students.
problemStatement: Students have different learning speeds and styles, yet traditional online learning systems are static and non-adaptive.
solution: Sahayak AI dynamically generates customized study content and structured learning paths based on student progress and interaction patterns.
impact: Sahayak AI enables personalized education at scale, bridging the gap between one-to-one tutoring and mass digital learning.
